description.p: Trier Bridge gives Windows users a familiar place for the things they already know how to do: files, apps, settings, printers, network, and familiar troubleshooting tools such as Task Manager and Event Viewer. Linux stays authoritative underneath; nothing runs as root.
This is a development build. Views that are not implemented say so and change nothing.

First release. In-app file browser with drive letters as labels, Task Manager with live performance graphs, branded launcher icons, a navy shell with an adjustable accent color and a zoom bar, an About page, protection for session-critical processes and services, and .deb installers as a default-app choice so a double-click installs through App Center.

Foundations 01 to 07 and the integrations: familiar tools, Bridge Terminal with PowerShell names, file operations, default apps, service control through polkit, setup screen, tray icon, search provider, Files menu.
